weather_report:
As the city sleeps under a thick blanket of clouds, the remnants of the marine layer linger around San Francisco, casting a tranquil, muted charm over the streets. With temperatures resting comfortably in the mid-60s overnight, a gentle south-southwest breeze whispers through, occasionally stirring the soft sea air. Yet, the promise of a brighter Wednesday looms ahead. As dawn breaks, the sun is set to emerge, gradually illuminating the urban landscape with a warm embrace, raising the temperature to a pleasant 85 degrees, before settling into a softer 81 in the afternoon. 

With the clarity of the day improving, the fog will gently retreat, revealing the iconic contours of the Golden Gate Bridge and the skyline, particularly inviting for a leisurely walk along the waterfront or a visit to one of the local markets, bustling with the aroma of fresh pastries and coffee. In the spirit of comfort, those stepping out may find light layers most agreeable; a breathable shirt complemented by a light jacket will keep one prepared for both warmth and the lingering whispers of coastal breezes. This day, tinged with a vibrant energy, invites one to savor simple pleasures—perhaps wandering through the Presidio or finding a quiet spot at Crissy Field to relish the view, where land and sea dance in a twilight embrace.
